metadata.title: 资金曲线与K线图融合分析

story.iWant: I want to see K-line trends and strategy fund curves on the same chart,
story.soThat: so that I can comprehensively evaluate the risk-return performance of the strategy.
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Dual Y-Axis Chart Foundation (AC: 1) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Create dual Y-axis chart configuration using Lightweight Charts 5.0.9 - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Implement left axis for price data and right axis for fund data - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Configure axis scaling and synchronization mechanisms - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Add axis labels and grid lines for both price and fund axes
- [ ] Task 2: Fund Curve Data Processing (AC: 2) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Create fund curve calculation service based on strategy signals - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Implement synchronized data scaling between price and fund data - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Add real-time fund curve updates during strategy parameter changes - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Implement smooth animations for fund curve transitions
- [ ] Task 3: Performance Metrics Display (AC: 3) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Create real-time performance metrics calculator - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Implement display panel for return rate, maximum drawdown, Sharpe ratio - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Add real-time updates of metrics during chart interactions - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Format and display metrics with appropriate precision and units
- [ ] Task 4: Baseline Comparison System (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Implement buy-and-hold strategy calculation as baseline - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Create baseline curve rendering with distinct visual style - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Add baseline comparison toggle and selection functionality - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Implement performance difference calculations and display
- [ ] Task 5: Performance Visualization Markers (AC: 5) - [ ] Subtask 5.1: Create drawdown area visualization with transparent overlays - [ ] Subtask 5.2: Implement profit range highlighting with color-coded zones - [ ] Subtask 5.3: Add interactive tooltips for performance regions - [ ] Subtask 5.4: Implement performance summary panel with key statistics

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Implement dual Y-axis chart design (left axis for price, right axis for funds) 2. Support synchronized zoom and pan of fund curves with K-line charts 3. Provide real-time display of key strategy return metrics (return rate, maximum drawdown, Sharpe ratio) 4. Support baseline comparison (such as buy-and-hold strategy) 5. Implement visual markers for strategy performance (drawdown areas, profit ranges)

doc.section: Story 3.4: 资金曲线与K线图融合分析
doc.snippet: 作为用户，我希望在同一图表上看到K线走势和策略资金曲线，以便全面评估策略的风险收益表现 Acceptance Criteria: 1. 实现双Y轴图表设计（左轴价格，右轴资金） 2. 支持资金曲线与K线图的同步缩放和平移

test.idea: Dual Y-axis rendering test: Verify left axis shows price data, right axis shows fund data with proper scaling
Synchronization test: Test zoom and pan operations maintain alignment between price and fund curves
Performance metrics test: Validate real-time calculation accuracy of return rate, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio
Baseline comparison test: Verify buy-and-hold strategy calculation and visual distinction
Visualization markers test: Test drawdown area overlays and profit range highlighting functionality
